rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural change: keep reverse-tail recurrence and quant-aware export intact, but progressively let recurrent tail outputs refresh the fixed decoder-output anchor only late in training. This targets the still-live anchor-variant category from local results without another weak scalar sweep, keeps shapes compile-stable, and adds no validation-path shortcuts.
title: Late Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Curriculum
